notes.text: Blind-audit findings: distinguish the unaccented baseline ordonne and left definition label def from separately accented occurrences. The terminal NB1 mark is a dash. The finite-case explanation has a closing parenthesis but no secure opening one. Final finie in the explanation of local finiteness is written with a small e. New uncertainties that preserve the preferred C reading are recorded as doubts, not new primary corrections.

The separator is retained on that independent visual evidence; the fixed second reading has not been altered or represented as having read the missing rule.

The nearby telle que after disjoints et follows the rising baseline in the wider image; it is not asserted to be a separate insertion.
